source: Table 1, Section 5, and Appendix C.2 of the author-supplied manuscript (docs/paper.pdf, pages 4 and 8).
status: Transcribed manuscript summaries; R1–R3 per-state predictions and fitted models are not included in this page's data bundle.

models.name: Structured features
models.description: 27 structured features. The message wording is absent.

models.name: + Framing label
models.description: The same features, plus an explicit label for the message framing.

models.name: + Text embedding
models.description: The same features, plus a frozen sentence embedding of the message.

models.name: + Compressed embedding
models.description: The same features, plus a 32-dimensional PCA projection of the embedding.

transfer.description: On the prespecified low-credibility subset where neither message appeared in training, R1–R3 did not improve on R0. Template novelty is nearly confounded with credibility and a smaller teacher effect. Wording transfer was not demonstrated.
transfer.metric: Mean absolute intervention-response error (EIR), in probability units; lower is better. Not recovery.
transfer.source: Appendix C.2, page 8 of docs/paper.pdf. Transcribed aggregate values; no per-state predictions are inferred.
